description:
DEPRECATED ALIAS of format_citation — kept for backward compatibility with v0.1.7 clients. New code should call format_citation directly.

WHEN TO USE: Reference lookups: individual code details, verifying a provider registry entry, checking a prior Medigami response's signature, or tracking an outcome.

WHEN NOT: For composite workflows use the higher-level tool that calls these internally.

envelope.description: Full signed envelope returned by an attested Medigami tool (preferred).

format.description: short = one-line citation string; long = paragraph attribution; both = return both (default).

tracking_id.description: tracking_id alone; the resulting URL will still render but the third party must paste the envelope into the verifier form.

name: format_medigami_citation
